crossRefs.note: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the…
The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and Yahweh blessed him.
Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Yahweh.
In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness…
the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’ ”
John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
translations.bsb: And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the wilderness until the time of his public appearance to Israel.
translations.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
translations.asv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his showing unto Israel.
